JournalEntry.title: JournalEntry
JournalEntry.description: A personal journal entry authored by an authenticated user.

userId.description: The authenticated owner's Firebase UID. Immutable after creation.

content.description: Full journal reflection text (1 to 20000 characters).

mood.description: Selected emotional mood for the entry.

favorite.description: Whether the entry is bookmarked as a favorite.

wordCount.description: Word count of the journal content (0 to 20000).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation. Immutable.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation and updates.

/users/{userId}/entries/{entryId}.description: Private user-scoped journal entries owned exclusively by {userId}.
